info.name: Understudy Desktop Agent Capabilities Supervision API

description.content: Authenticated loopback API for agents operating a running Understudy Desktop app. The desktop capability file supplies the ephemeral base URL and bearer token. Prompts, images, traces, and model outputs remain local unless a caller explicitly selects a remote route.
